observations: The major isolated Kolguyev shape is recognizable in both before and modern donor views.
Differences occur chiefly around the southwest/south coast and eastern coastal inlets. No mainland or political connection is introduced.
All 18 modern components are included, including components too small to distinguish at this nominal scale; inclusion is established by coordinate ledger, not visibility.
The same complete old/new group applies to all three selected versions. The 1930-1991 USSR and 1991 RSFSR versions already contain the same modern group geometrically.
limits: No physical-screen calibration or independent historical coast-position measurement.
Projected old-versus-modern display difference is not evidence of a historical territorial gain or loss.
